bullets.text: Combatting Scam Calls - **UK** telcos unite under a new **Telecommunications Fraud Charter** to tackle scam calls effectively.
Zoom's UK Data Centre - **Zoom** plans to open a UK data centre in 2026 to enhance local data residency and compliance.
BT's Revenue Decline - **BT** reports a 3% drop in revenue, prompting significant job cuts amid competitive pressures.
AI in Mobile Forensics - **Jamf** launches AI Analysis for iOS forensics, enhancing mobile threat detection and response.
Open RAN Testing Expansion - **Digital Catapult** welcomes new vendors to accelerate **Open RAN** trials in the UK.
Telefónica's Growth Strategy - **Telefónica** unveils a strategic plan focusing on AI-driven innovation and operational efficiency.
Changing Video Consumption - Over half of **UK** viewers now watch content via apps, posing new data challenges for enterprises.
MNOs Embrace New Models - Mobile operators are shifting towards managed overlays and consumption-based models in enterprise connectivity.
AWS's Fastnet Cable - **AWS** announces a new transatlantic cable, Fastnet, to enhance cloud and AI traffic resilience.
BT's 5G Leadership - **BT** maintains its top mobile network status for the 12th year, expanding 5G coverage to 66%.
